Package dev.px.core.hud

Class Placement

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.hud.Placement
public final class Placement extends Object
An element resolved for one frame: where it ended up and how big it is.

Produced by

invalid @link 
HudService#resolve()
, consumed by rendering, hit testing and the editor. It exists so those three agree on geometry by construction rather than by each recomputing it and hoping they match.

The distinction between

invalid @link 
#getNatural()
and
invalid @link 
#getBounds()
is the scale factor. An element draws at natural size inside a scale transform; the bounds are what it actually occupies on screen and are what anchoring, clamping and hit testing use.

    • shape

      public Shape shape()
      The element's interaction region in screen space.

      Built at natural size and then scaled about the element's top-left, which is why an element never has to account for its own scale when overriding HudElement.getShape(float, float, float, float).
